<tool_call>

from collections import deque
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def isFloor(r,c):
    if not(0<=r<64 and 0<=c<64): return False
    ch=a[r][c]
    if ch in ('G','Y'): return True
    return (40<=r<=44 and 29<=c<=33)
def validTL(r,c):
    if r%5!=0 or c%5!=4: return False
    return all(isFloor(rr,cc) for rr in range(r,r+5) for cc in range(c,c+5))
start=(40,29)
par={start:None}; q=deque([start])
while q:
    cur=q.popleft(); r,c=cur
    for dr,dc in [(-5,0),(5,0),(0,-5),(0,5)]:
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if (nr,nc) not in par and validTL(nr,nc):
            par[(nr,nc)]=cur; q.append((nr,nc))
def path(to):
    if to not in par: return None
    p=[]; cur=to
    while par[cur] is not None:
        r,c=cur; pr,pc=par[cur]
        d='UP' if pr==r+5 else 'DOWN' if pr==r-5 else 'LEFT' if pc==c+5 else 'RIGHT'
        p.append(d); cur=par[cur]
    return p[::-1]
p1=path((15,14))
print("ring1 path len",len(p1),p1)
# Execute the path to ring1
res=action(p1)
print("result keys:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete']})
